long_biography.plain_text:
Robert Julien studied business at McGill University before building his career in South Florida real estate. He founded the Kolter Group in 1997 and developed it from an early residential platform into a diversified investment and development business. As chief executive, he set overall strategy while supporting leaders of specialised portfolio companies.

Julien's work spans land acquisition and entitlement, master-planned communities, homebuilding, luxury condominiums, multifamily housing and hospitality assets. He has participated across the development cycle, from financing and design through construction, marketing and disposition. Kolter's expansion across the southeastern United States and other North American markets has paired large-scale residential delivery with selective commercial and hotel development. He also became chair of NorthWest Healthcare Properties' board after Kolter accumulated a substantial strategic investment in the trust.
